Metadata.CommitMsg:
Build the Postgres image from source on UBI 10

Replace postgres:16-alpine with PostgreSQL 17.11 built from the checksum-pinned
source tarball on ubi10/ubi:10.2, with its own entrypoint. Update the compose
file and vuln_scan.sh to match. Data volumes from the old image need a
pg_dump/pg_restore.
